# Run book: Search passages by keyword, meaning and both

[Run books](README.md) | [User guide](../user-guide/search-three-ways.md) | [Spec](../specs/search-three-ways.md)

## Contents

- [Purpose](#purpose)

## Purpose

See why keyword search misses paraphrases, why embeddings rank everything, and how rank fusion combines them, with the scoring in plain view.

## Preconditions

- The all-MiniLM embedder is available in the API.

## Verify

Automatically: `npx playwright test e2e/journeys.spec.ts -g "Search passages by keyword, meaning and both"` (add `E2E_BASE_URL=http://localhost:8088` to run against the compose stack).

By hand, in the example web application at `/ai/search`:

1. **Review the passages and the query.** Sample passages and a query are filled in. Separate your own passages with a blank line. Expect: The Search button is enabled.
2. **Search.** The same query runs by keywords (BM25), by meaning (embeddings) and by reciprocal rank fusion of both. Expect: Three result lists are shown. The first list has a hit with a score.

## Troubleshooting

**Table 1 — Known problems**

| Symptom | Likely cause | Fix |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Keywords find nothing | The query shares no word with any passage | Use the meaning or hybrid list, or reword the query |
| Bad request | The query or the passages are empty | Fill in both |

Related framework features: OoBDev.Onnx.SentenceEmbeddings; OoBDev.AI.Abstractions (`IEmbeddingProvider`).
